programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hilary continue to rise.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: The Master Of Disguise
programme.desc: A man with the newfound ability to disguise himself begins a mission to rescue his father from a domestic terrorist.

programme.title: Apple Of My Eye
programme.desc: A young girl struggles after a traumatic horse riding accident causes her to lose her eyesight. Charles, the head trainer of Southeastern Guide Dogs, trains Apple, a miniature horse, to be her companion and surrogate eyes.

programme.title: Ice Castles
programme.desc: Alexis Winston is a young girl who dreams of becoming a champion figure skater. While practicing, Alexis suffers a terrible accident that takes her sight and threatens to destroy her dreams. With help from her family and a new love, she realizes that she can still fulfill her dreams.

programme.title: Places In The Heart
programme.desc: In depression America, hardship was everywhere, survival was a struggle, and hope was hidden in places in the heart.

programme.title: Home Invasion
programme.desc: A botched robbery turns into a hostage crisis as a gang of armed criminals holds a woman and four children captive while police surround the house.

programme.title: Dirty
programme.desc: Hard-edged story of a gangbanger turned cop who is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue all in the course of one day.

programme.title: Against All Odds
programme.desc: Dark passions explode in this steamy, sinister love story starring Rachel Ward and Jeff Bridges. Terry Brogan (Bridges), a cynical ex-football star, is hired to find Jessie Wyler (Ward), the runaway mistress of a ruthless L.A. nightclub owner, Jake Wise (James Woods). According to Jake, Jessie had stabbed him and vanished with $50,000. But Terry s mission is soon forgotten when he tracks down and falls in love with the beautiful Jessie on a Mexican island. Trouble brews, however, when Jake dispatches his henchman, Hank Sully (Alex Karras), to bring the lovers back. Driven by passion for the mysterious young woman, Terry quickly finds himself trapped in a complex web of corruption, betrayal,and murder. Packed with riveting excitement and vivid sensuality, AGAINST ALL ODDS grabs you and never lets you go.

programme.title: Scandal Sheet
programme.desc: A newspaper editor's efforts to end his ex-wife's blackmail attempt become the focus of an investigative story by his ambitious protégé.

programme.title: To Sir, With Love
programme.desc: An unemployed engineer takes a job as a teacher of hostile and rebellious students in their last year at a high school in London's tough East End.

programme.title: 5 Against The House
programme.desc: A college prank to rob a casino goes awry when one of the participants, a psychotic Korean War vet, decides that it isn't just a game.

programme.title: The Magic Carpet
programme.desc: Arabian Nights-type of tale stars Agar as a deposed prince trying to free his people from the evil rule of the caliph, the princess Narah (Lucille Ball) and his vizier, played by Burr. Agar enlists the aid of harem girl Patricia Medina and together they win back the province, while zipping around on a flying carpet.

programme.title: The Game That Kills

Tingle says she can’t trust her husband, Hermann. She says he lied about how many times he’d been married, and when she discovered he was registered on a singles dating site, he told her that he was doing research for a friend! She says she’s also suspicious of her spouse’s low sex drive and fears he may be getting his needs met elsewhere. Hermann says he wants to regain his wife’s trust but says he can’t handle her insecurity. Should Tingle give him another chance or kick him to the curb? And, when Elizabeth was last on the show, she wanted to know once and for all if her husband, Shawn, was being unfaithful. Find out why Shawn initially agreed to take a polygraph test but later declined. Can this relationship be saved?

Tony says he was vulnerable and lonely, and he believed the older man was his best friend. Tony claims the man gave him dangerous, addictive drugs, telling him it was candy, and videotaped Tony being sexually abused. The man even followed Tony’s family when they moved to a new state, and he eventually abducted Tony. Authorities say they believe he had a sinister and dark plan for the little boy. Today, Tony speaks out for the first time about what happened to him.

programme.title: El Rastro

Tras descartar la hipótesis inicial, la investigación llevó a la captura de Eduardo Osa, compañero universitario, cuya culpabilidad quedó demostrada. La necropsia reveló asfixia mecánica. Osa aceptó los cargos y fue condenado a 26 años por homicidio y ocultamiento de pruebas.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Hace 21 años, paramilitares asesinaron a 60 personas en la masacre de El Salado. Jairo Castillo, alias 'Pitirri', ex paramilitar y testigo clave, acusa a Enilce López, "La Gata", de participar en el crimen. Su testimonio ha enviado a varios a prisión, incluyendo revelaciones sobre el asesinato de la fiscal Yolanda Paternina. Hoy, exiliado en Canadá, Pitirri vive bajo amenazas de muerte por sus declaraciones.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Tres historias: Patricia Osorio busca justicia tras el suicidio de su hijo Daniel, quien denunció abuso sexual por parte de un cura antes de morir. Y un profesor francés de 90 años dona su fortuna a mujeres que dejaron la prostitución, encontrando un nuevo hogar junto a ellas.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: La pandemia disparó la violencia intrafamiliar en Colombia, con 360 feminicidios en 2020. En respuesta, el psicólogo Raúl Suárez lidera escuelas de "nuevas masculinidades", inspiradas en el feminicidio de Maira Barahona en 2016. La iniciativa Bochica enseña a hombres crianza, tareas domésticas y masculinidades no violentas a través de talleres, buscando romper estereotipos de género desde la infancia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa expulsa furiosamente a Consuelo y Blanca del hospital. Carmen Rosa cuenta a Rosa que aceptó la ayuda de Erasto por desesperación. José Luis enfrenta a Erasto en la fiesta del gimnasio y es expulsado por seguridad. Carlos propone a Marisela ayudarla con su alcoholismo. Vilma orquesta el secuestro de Leticia mediante delincuentes contratados. Alejandro le confiesa a José Luis que se mudará a casa de los Alamo para estar cerca de Rosa. Natalia pacta con criminales para hacerle daño a alguien, complicando aún más la red de intrigas.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Enzo le dice a Vicky que quiere terminar su relación porque está enamorado de Milagros. Ella trata de convencerlo diciéndole todo el amor que siente por él, pero Enzo insiste en estar enamorado de Milagros, entonces Victoria se desespera y le dice que va a luchar por él. Amada lo cita Germán a su casa y le ordena que realice un atentado en contra de Clemencia Talamonti Clemencia citó a Luis Francisco en un lugar rodeado de vagabundos, que es el sitio en donde la dejaron abandonada a ella.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de que Cristóbal se enterara la verdad acerca de que su Ana era la misma Ana de la historia de amor de Guillermo, rompe su relación con ella, por lo que Marilda y Guillermo encuentran la oportunidad de volver con sus respectivos amores. Pero Onofre le aconseja a Cristóbal que no se separe, y vuelve al ruedo cuando le perdona a Ana la mentira, y le pide nuevamente que se case con él. Mientras que Venancio continúa en la búsqueda del asesino por el envenenado del acotamiento, otra muerte sucumbe al condominio: Diego, el vecino del cuarto piso, apareció sin vida en su apartamento por presunta muerte natural.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le dice a Magdalena que con ella es diferente que se está enamorando pero ella no le cree nada y piensa que con todas es igual. Valentina le cuenta a Epicúreo toda la historia de su hija y le confirma que es Julieta Fernández, la hija de Efraín y Ana Belén. Ana habla por celular con Julieta y le dice que hubo un error, que ella no hablo con el doctor Salas, que es su mamá pero Julieta no confía plenamente y luego cuando llega a la casa encuentra unas fotos raras y se dedica a averiguar que es lo que pasa. Ricardo acuerda con Julieta que publicará en “La Deslenguada” que lo de Magdalena y Gabriel fueron rumores infundados pero con una condición, que vaya a la casa con Jamer y le averigüe todo sobre Magdalena Miranda.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo busca consejo en Manuela tras la muerte de Celia. Ella le sugiere mudarse con sus hijos, mientras Jade insulta a Benjamín tratándolo como Néstor Cordido. En el cementerio, Elizabeth y Moisés sufren por la pérdida. María del Pilar anuncia su embarazo a René y Gustavo, generando dudas sobre la paternidad de Marcelo. Finalmente, Hortensia y Benjamín planean viajar con Glorita, y Cecilia regresa al hato para organizar el futuro de sus sobrinos tras hallar sobres escritos por Celia.

programme.desc: Get ready for an exciting Mixed Split Pro Age pickleball match featuring the formidable team of Jaime Oncins and Simone Jardim against the new pairing of Ryan Miscik and Christie Domoracki. Oncins is a former professional tennis player from Brazil. His partner, Simone Jardim, is a professional pickleball player, a Pickleball Hall of Fame inductee, and was once ranked the number one female player in the world. They face a new team with Ryan Miscik, a pro pickleball player and coach based in Venice, Florida. His partner, Christie Domoracki, is a player located in Boca Grande, Florida. This match brings together a mix of experienced pros and up-and-coming talent for a high-stakes competition on Florida's Paradise Coast.

This is a classic 1 vs. 4 match-up, with the winner stamping their ticket to Championship Sunday.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.sub-title: NCPA 2026 - Purdue Boilermakers vs. Liberty Flames
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center reaches a fever pitch as the #8 seed Purdue Boilermakers and #9 seed Liberty Flames collide in a Round of 16 battle with a $1,000 bounty on the line. The Racing intensity of the match is underscored by "nasty rips" and rapid-fire exchanges that leave no room for error. Technical Skills are on full display as players execute precision "Ernie" maneuvers and high-level dinking strategies at the kitchen line. In a Freestyle display of collegiate grit, both programs fight through momentum shifts and "money bag" pressures to prove they belong among the nation's elite.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.sub-title: Women's Senior Singles Final - Linton vs. Tampieri
programme.desc: Witness one of the most exciting finals from the European Pickleball Championships 2025 in Rome. In the Women's Senior Singles Open Final, Team England’s Anna Linton takes on Team Italy’s Paola Tampieri at the iconic Stadio dei Marmi. Linton starts with commanding form, dominating the first game with powerful forehand drives. However, the momentum shifts as Tampieri, fueled by a passionate home crowd, adjusts her strategy to target Linton’s backhand and level the match.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The 2024 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches a fever pitch in Dallas as the North Carolina Tar Heels and the Utah Tech Trailblazers meet for a legendary semifinal rematch of their 2022 title bout. With both teams deeply familiar with one another’s strategies, the atmosphere at Brookhaven Country Club is electric, featuring elite players like Sarah Carpenter and Avery Beck battling for every point. The high-intensity matches, including women’s and men’s doubles, push these athletes to their limits as they fight to avoid another heart-pounding "dream breaker" finish. This high-stakes showdown captures the pure spirit of collegiate pickleball, where technical precision and emotional resilience decide who advances to face the defending champions.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches its peak as the University of Florida and the University of Virginia face off in a high-stakes Semifinal and Final showdown. The intensity is palpable from the very first "time in," with athletes showcasing elite precision in specialized Skills challenges and explosive speed during the high-octane Racing segments. Between strategic volleys and creative Freestyle maneuvers, neither side gives an inch as the score oscillates through razor-thin margins, trading momentum with every "right back" play. This clash of titans proves why these two programs are the gold standard of collegiate pickleball, where every "point two" earned is a grueling step toward national history.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Ya No Tengo Miedo
programme.desc: Una vez más, el infalible plan de Gargamel para atrapar a los Pitufos ha fracasado. Los Pitufos aprovechan para gastarle una broma: disfrazados de pequeños ángeles azules, le enseñarán a enmendar su conducta….

programme.title: El Capricho De Travieso
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que, si atrapas un trol, este puede concederte un deseo? Resulta que Aloysius el trol ha quedado atrapado en una de las pitufitrampas de Gargamel. Pitufo Colérico le libera y, como recompensa, consigue que los demás Pitufos satisfagan todos sus caprichos. Esto acarrea un montón de problemas para los Pitufos, ya que los Pitufitos, en ocasiones, piden cosas que no son buenas para ellos… ni tampoco para los demás.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Miedoso entra corriendo en la aldea y grita que el cielo se está cayendo. Justo en ese mismo momento, Papá Pitufo está aquejado de un incontrolable ataque de estornudos….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Poeta y Pintor se sienten poco valorados y huyen a una isla tormentosa sin saber que Gargamel los sigue hasta allí.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: El Amo Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador es el reticente amo de un genio llamado Gourdy, cuyo entusiasmo por ser servicial es quizá algo excesivo. Tras un nuevo incidente provocado por el exceso de celo de Gourdy, Pitufo Labrador le dice algo que no debería haber dicho y Gourdy desaparece. ¿Y a que no adivinas quién lo encuentra? En efecto: Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. ¿Y quién podría arrebatar a Gourdy de las manos de Escrupuloso, sino el propio Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Pitufo Carpintero se encuentra con una anciana trol en el bosque, que le suplica que le ayude a librarse de un grano rojo que tiene en la nariz… ¡dándole un buen puntapié! Pitufo Carpintero la ayuda sin mucho convencimiento. Y el resultado resulta sorprendente para él.

programme.title: Pitufan Nuestra Canción
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a la flauta mágica de Woody para que la música que salga de ella pase de ser buena a ser mala. Gargamel captura a los Pitufos, pero Sasita les salva diciéndole a Gargamel que le ama. Este toca la flauta, pero la música se desvanece a medida que Gargamel se ve inundado de sentimientos de amor, y termina por liberar a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tontín y Pitufina son capturados para ser exhibidos en una Feria. Papá Pitufo aprovecha la torpeza de Gargamel para rescatarlos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Natural y Travieso roban la fórmula de Gargamel para hacer otro Pitufo - otra pitufa para acompañar a Pitufina. Así pues, crean a Sassette, que crea problemas por doquier. Haciendo uso de su poción, Papá Pitufo convierte la malvada creación de Gargamel en una simpática Sassette.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: El Pitufo De Troya
programme.desc: Gargamel, el malvado mago, ha ideado un nuevo plan para capturar a los Pitufos: ha construido una estatua gigante con la forma de Papá Pitufo. Espera que, al verla, los Pitufos lleven la estatua a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está harto. Los Pitufitos y Sasita siguen inventándose historias sobre él con desagradables consecuencias. Por eso, prepara una fórmula mágica, extraída del libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo, que hace que los pequeños Pitufos crezcan y crezcan cada vez que dicen mentiras. Pero no había contado con que ahora Gargamel tiene una forma de capturar a los Pitufitos.

programme.title: La Brigada De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando en la Aldea Pitufa forman una brigada de incendios para combatir las llamas que devoran la cocina de Pitufo Goloso, se dan cuenta de que Gargamel les ha dejado sin agua. Sin embargo, no se da cuenta de la fragilidad de su presa, que se rompe y provoca que el agua arrastre a Gargamel y Azrael e inunde la Aldea Pitufa, extinguiendo el fuego.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Mejor Memoria De La Aldea
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un loco experimento, Pitufo Torpe puede ahora almacenar interminables conocimientos en su memoria. Gargamel lo captura e intenta que le revele la fórmula de invisibilidad de Papá Pitufo, pero, en el último segundo, Pitufo Torpe le engaña diciéndole unos ingredientes erróneos.

programme.title: Cosas Que Putifan En La Noche
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Colérico pierde a su oso de peluche Huggy, no consigue dormir a pesar de los esfuerzos de Papá Pitufo por convencerle de que los osos de peluche son mágicos y pueden cuidar de sí mismos. Gargamel se tropieza con la Aldea Pitufa y Huggy regresa convertido en un oso gigante para espantar y salvar a Pitufo Colérico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Indeciso, tal como su nombre indica, no consigue decidirse sobre nada. Los otros Pitufos le llevan al bosque para hacer una prueba de supervivencia en la que únicamente pueda encontrar el camino de vuelta a casa tomando decisiones. Sin embargo, acaba en el castillo de Baltasar.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un hechizo ha alterado las cajas sorpresa explosivas de Pitufo Bromista. Imagina la cara de desconcierto que se le queda a este guasón cuando se da cuenta de que todas las sorpresas que entrega a otros incautos Pitufos en realidad contienen regalos. ¡Se acabaron las explosiones, las bromas y la diversión! Y a eso se le une su poco envidiable posición como el Pitufo más popular de la aldea, rodeado de admiradores que no cesan de pedirle más obsequios….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogata consigue los pendientes dorados mágicos de Sonoria, que le permitirán oír las voces de los Pitufos desde lejos. Siguiendo los ronquidos de Pitufo Perezoso, está a punto de llegar hasta la Aldea Pitufa, pero entonces los sonidos del cuerno de Pitufo Armonía comienzan a resonar en sus pendientes y huye enfurecida de vuelta a casa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Fortachón descubre a un caballero que lo ayuda a combatir a un Dragón, pero éste huye y deja a Fortachón defendiendo a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aman las trufas y las trufas son de los Trolls. No será nada fácil que los pitufitos azules tengan un banquete.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Monstruosos
programme.desc: Es la noche de los fantasmas y todos los Pitufos se preparan para la elegante fiesta de disfraces… pero Pitufo Filósofo se hace con el libro de magia de Papá Pitufo y todos los Pitufos se transforman en criaturas horrendas, aunque divertidas. No obstante, el peligro acecha….

programme.title: Una Campana Para Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a una campana atada a la cola de Azrael que conducirá al gato hasta los Pitufos. Pero Papá Pitufo es más astuto que él y lanza un contra hechizo que lleva al mago hasta Gigantón, en lugar de hasta los deliciosos Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En el Día de la Infelicidad, los Pitufos tienen que ser infelices para poder apreciar su felicidad durante el resto del año. Gargamel inventa un detector de felicidad para encontrar a los Pitufos, pero lo usa justo el único día en el que los Pitufos no son felices. En su lugar, encuentra a una pareja de dragones felices y desata su ira.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos sabemos que Pitufo Gruñón odia varias cosas. Pero la cosa que odia más que nada es el agua, cuando hay suficiente para que se pueda ahogar. Pitufo Gruñón no sabe nadar. Y cuando los Pitufos notan esto y le tratan de enseñar cómo sobrevivir en el agua, el malvado mago Gargamel hace que todo sea un poco más peligroso de lo que debería ser...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Epidemia De La Tos Saltarina
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Delta Wing Racer with a Vengance - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Henry Ford III & Counterfeit Cars - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me - SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving in beautiful Mauritius Brent has his first taste of their curry. The Indian population has had a huge influence on the cuisine, but Mauritian curries are unique. Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: The French are famous for their haute cuisine with its extravagant presentations and complex techniques. After swimming with wild dolphins Brent meets with Michael Scioli, head chef at the prestigious hotel, Le Constance Prince Maurice on the east coast of the Island. Chef Michael shows him how to prepare a specialized French seafood dish using ingredients straight from the hotel's garden. Seeing as you can never have too much adventure, Brent then tries out fly and dive boarding (mainly dive) which is essentially a water powered jet pack. After an afternoon of fun, he limps into the hotel veggie garden to pick some ingredients for his own feast of French fusion prawns and coconut heart salad as the sun sets on anther beautiful day in paradise.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with an undersea walk before heading to Port Louis to meet Lloyd in Chinatown. A massive archway welcomes him onto the busy Chinatown streets and Brent and Lloyd whet their appetites with some Chinese street food. The Chinese influence on Mauritian food has been huge and there have been more than a few fusion dishes to come out of their Chinatown. Brent and Lloyd head to a local Chinese restaurant to try a popular dish that is unique to Mauritius, a Bol Renverse, an "upside-down bowl". After a delicious lunch Lloyd has a treat planned for Brent. He takes him to the Kwan Tee Pagoda, the oldest Pagoda in Mauritius and believed to be the oldest in the Southern Hemisphere. After a magical day Brent head's back to his hotel inspired and ready to cook up a storm. The next day Brent goes in search of ingredients in a local Chinese supermarket and then heads to a peaceful garden to cook his mustard pork with a twist.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Sugar is commonly known on the island as the Mauritian Miracle, having once been the backbone of Mauritius's economy. Brent visits L'Adventure du Sucre museum and gets a fascinating look at how the Mauritian history is tightly intertwined with sugar. He then heads in to the fields to for some fun cutting cane before meeting up with Chef Oliver and who shows Brent just how much Mauritians love sugar and spice. Brent then heads out to the stunning and exclusive island, Ile Des Deux Cocos, for some snorkeling in a marine sanctuary and then cooks up his own Mauritian tropical desert on a remote coral beach.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is covered in sugar cane plantations and Mauritian rum is growing fast on the international market. Brent heads to St Aubin, an estate with one of the oldest sugar cane fields and a factory that produces both artisanal and traditional rums. There he not only tastes the rum but learns all about making it too. It's a good thing he has nothing else planned that day. The next morning Brent visits a nearby market to buy his ingredients and then gets his adrenaline pumping with a wild tubing experience where he learns just how solid water is, again and again, and again. He then heads off on a sunset catamaran cruise where he cooks up a delicious caramel, rum, jerked chicken dish, finishing off the day with a rum cocktail. Is it the waves making him unsteady on his feet or all the rum?

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent looks back on his time in Mauritius. Everything he's learnt, the laughs, the people, the food. Co-existence amongst the Indian, African, European and Chinese locals has led to a sharing of cultures and values, giving the Mauritians a great sense of national pride and Brent can feel it. An island commonly associated with coconuts and cocktails is proven to be so much deeper and after being welcomed into homes, sacred places of worship and given family cooking secrets, Brent is left feeling like he is part of the Mauritian family.

programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: In this episode, Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest. Over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys. But the adventure doesn’t end at the dock—Cullen also experiences Key West’s world-class accommodations, exceptional food, and one-of-a-kind island lifestyle. From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world’s premier fishing and vacation destinations.

programme.desc: Brody obtém sua Insígnia de Voo do Comando Aéreo quando Shirley acidentalmente decola com o Comando Aéreo! / Baddy McBat pega o Splash-Diver de Brody, e o utiliza para escaper com raras e valiosas pérolas roxas.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: O Capitão Dilly e os Cadetes constroem um Parque Aquático Pirata no Cânion do Splash. Mas a Capitã Swabby pega os baús de tesouro! / Os Dodôs pensam que Brody é o lendário Rei dos Dodôs e fazem tudo que ele diz até que Baddy Morcegão pega a coroa!

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Chomps e Rocco desafiam Brody e Penny em uma competição aquática, mas Rocco quase cai das Cachoeiras Gêmeas! / Os primos de Shirley vêm da cidade para visitar a Big Swirl. As coisas não saem bem como o planejado na excursão pela ilha.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.sub-title: Survivor Bear and the Secret of Ker-Splash Canyon/Great Ker-Splash Race
programme.desc: Della ajuda o Ursobrevivente a explorar as cavernas secretas do Cânion do Splash. Os Cadetes precisam escapar antes que fiquem presos nas cavernas para sempre! / Baddy trapaceia para tentar vencer a Corrida do Cânion do Splash.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Nossos cadetes devem resgatar o velho esquilo Earl e correr com ele de volta para a Ilha antes que a sua avelã-móvel estrague por completo a festa de aniversário / O inspetor quer enviar os nossos cadetes para outros centros de Treinamentos Top Wing.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.sub-title: Dodo Egg Scramble/Trini's Trin-Tastic Big Swirl Tour
programme.desc: Quando os ovos da Dodô Della são levados pela água, é a vez dos nossos queridos cadetes entrarem em ação para resgatar os irmãozinhos da Della./Quando Baddy leva a Trini em um tour para conhecer a Ilha Big Swirl eles quase ficam presos na Caverna.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.sub-title: Baddy and the Bad Wings/Cheep and Chirp's Splashy Surf Show
programme.desc: Baddy se junta com Betty, Chomps e Rocco para formar uma equipe do mal, a Equipe Bad Wings, e roubar o Comando Aéreo da Equipe Top Wing para dominar a Ilha Big Swirl./David Silva Leitão tem de ficar no lugar de Brody e treinar Cheep.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: O Blaze e seu motorista AJ são apresentados ao mundo da corrida de Monster Machines! Quando um carro chamado Esmagador utiliza golpes sujos para tentar ganhar o campeonato, Blaze fará tudo que puder para ajudar seus amigos.

programme.title: Blaze e os Monster Machines
programme.desc: Quase chegando na pista, Esmagador cria uma nova armadilha e atira bolas de barro gigantes. Finalmente, AJ e Blaze conseguem destruir as bolas de lodo construindo um pulverizador gigante de água.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: O longo tempo de convivência e a expectativa de ganharem o jogo começa a gerar intrigas na casa.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: A nostalgia e a expectativa da casa aumentam com a proximidade do final de mais uma temporada.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Acompanhe o especial de Are you The One? Brasil e descubra como anda a vida dos participantes da 2 temporada.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Vinte solteiros chegam à nova casa do Are You The One? Brasil em Trancoso, na Bahia. As primeiras afinidades começam a aparecer e um casal mais agilizado estreia o "quartão" em grande estilo.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Um novo participante entra na casa e os ânimos continuam mais do que agitados. E uma fofoca vira discórdia geral: a maior briga de todos os tempos do Are You The One? Brasil está prestes a acontecer.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Mais um capítulo da novela Ana Bárbara e Felipe: ela quer saber a todo custo quem está se atirando para cima dele. E ainda: um casal que ensaiava se aproximar, finalmente dá o primeiro beijo e o "Quartinho do Amor" pega fogo.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Nem mesmo a ressaca da última treta impede Ana de se surpreender com a entrada de uma terceira pessoa no "relacionamento" dela com Felipe. E Rafael, cansado de ser considerado somente um brother, tenta chegar junto.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Os participantes questionam a eficiência da estratégia utilizada até agora. E um dos casais mais amados desta temporada põe em xeque seu amor na Cabine da Verdade e a volta de Caique arranca suspiros de uma gata em especial.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Um novo e tímido casal se forma, unindo duas pontas do país. Irina revela quem é seu crush e Allan e Andressa continuam aproveitando o "Quartinho do Amor", mas todo esse love pode virar lágrimas a qualquer momento.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: O progresso rumo aos dez fachos de luz anima a casa, especialmente Larissa que encabeçou a "matemática". E também: os participantes revelam seus segredos na hora do sexo e uma brincadeira acaba indo longe demais para alguns.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Uma visita inesperada mexe com os nervos e os ânimos de todos na casa. Casais, amizades e parcerias ficam no passado. Esse é um episódio para entrar para a história da MTV. Vai perder?

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Depois de uma briga épica, Allan e Andressa precisam de tempo para se recuperar. E os participantes se mostram preocupados diante do fracasso de poucos fachos de luz acesos nessa reta final do jogo.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Nem mesmo um luau na praia acalma o ânimo dos participantes. Deixando a convivência de lado, há um objetivo comum que é encontrar os parceiros e ganhar os 500 mil reais, resta saber se eles têm o incentivo, o sentimento e a estratégia para isso.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma mulher inconsciente está com hemorragia interna. Os médicos tentam convencer o cirurgião a assumir o caso. Um homem com uma ereção de quatro dias precisa de uma ajuda extraordinária. Uma mulher chega com uma faca no peito.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: O cirurgião Joe Eric Johnston tem a difícil missão de salvar um homem com um gancho de aço de dois quilos empalado em seu crânio. Há fofocas no banheiro, a Dra. Dee L'Archeveque admite que um paciente morreu enquanto defecava.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Os paramédicos vão às pressas ao local de um acidente em uma rodovia. O Dr. Eric Maniago já cuidou de muitas pessoas importantes, mas quando uma princesa chega à emergência ele se vê em um terreno desconhecido.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma jovem está com hemorragia interna por conta de uma gravidez ectópica, mas nega ter feito sexo, então seu médico precisa achar um jeito de provar a sua gravidez antes de tratá-la. Uma jovem mãe oscila entre a vida e a morte.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: O motorista Chris Valderas fica severamente ferido em um acidente de carro e a equipe de médicos da emergência trabalha duro para salvar a sua vida. Uma garota chinesa de 6 anos é levada às pressas à emergência com convulsões graves e contínuas.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Quando Kassie Arner de 11 anos de idade chega ao hospital infantil de Phoenix, o pediatra da UTI acha que ela irá morrer. Os paramédicos levam ao hospital uma garota adolescente que se recusa a falar e aparentemente está com medo de se mexer.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Depois de sofrer maus-tratos severos, a jovem e linda Anne chega ao hospital com ferimentos que ameaçam a sua vida e com metade do seu rosto desfigurado. Uma mulher rica chega à emergência se queixando de tontura e confusão.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma jovem desorientada e fantasiada de coelhinho chega à emergência. Uma médica não consegue tratar de um corte na mão de seu namorado. Um jovem perde a sensibilidade das pernas… ou será que não?

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem foi esmagado por uma caçamba e escapa da morte. Uma freira idosa e uma prostituta embriagada, que não para de gritar, chegam à emergência na mesma hora. Uma mulher que está quase morrendo por causa de um derrame pode ter uma doença rara.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma mulher com chiados chega à emergência com problemas respiratórios. Um homem adulto repentinamente começa a agir como criança. Uma festa de aniversário tem problemas quando a família toda vai parar na emergência fatalmente doente.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma madrinha de casamento entra em um perigoso coma alcoólico. As pupilas de um homem incham. Um bebê prematuro é deixado no banheiro do hospital e precisa ser rapidamente reanimado na emergência.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma estudante desmaia na emergência e os médicos fazem RCP por horas na esperança de que ela sobreviva. Um homem com uma ereção de cinco horas é encontrado entre a sua esposa e sua amante e uma avó de 70 anos acorda depois de ser declarada morta.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem leva uma picada fatal de uma cascavel, mas por razões religiosas não pode receber uma transfusão de sangue. Será que ele sobreviverá?

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um prisioneiro pode estar fingindo paralisia para fugir da prisão. Um jovem parece estar sufocado sem razão. Um pai é esfaqueado no coração quando tenta proteger seu filho. Uma líder de torcida da faculdade tem uma parada cardíaca misteriosa.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Pedaços de Vidro de 12 Centímetros no Cérebro. Coágulo Sanguíneo Assassino. Suicida Com Arma. O Paciente Border Collie. Aguentando Firme no Pronto-Socorro.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: David Hasselhoff resgata Arnold e Dudley bem a tempo, e o resto da família descobre os planos de casamento do Sr. Drummond. Arnold não fica nem um pouco feliz, especialmente quando descobre que vai ganhar um novo irmãozinho como parte do acordo.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Com a família e os amigos reunidos, Phillip e Maggie se encontram no altar, mas percebem que cada um cometeu um grande erro, na parte final de uma história especial de duas partes.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold e Pearl caem em depressão quando Maggie e Phillip retornam de sua lua de mel e dispensam Pearl temporariamente do serviço, e ordenam que Arnold cuide de seu irmãozinho Sam em vez de ir à uma festa.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Na busca por uma religião, iniciada por Maggie e seu pai, Arnold acha que a encontrou depois de participar de um impressionante bar mitzvah, onde seu amigo "se torna um homem" aos 13 anos.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O dinheiro que a turma de Arnold arrecadou e deixou aos cuidados dele para os Jogos Nacionais de Cadeira de Rodas desapareceu, deixando Arnold constrangido e a família deprimida.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O lar dos Drummond encara o problema de Sam em fazer xixi na cama, tentando de tudo: Desde a repreensão até a adulação, mas apenas causando mais frustração e dor em Sam.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Drummond é acusado de não ser cortês com seus empregados, ele aceita secretamente um trabalho em uma de suas próprias indústrias, na área de linha de montagem.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Willis vira o intermediário em um esforço policial para impedir o uso e o tráfico de drogas em sua escola de ensino médio.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold arrisca ser expulso da escola ao liderar uma greve contra as novas regras que ele acha serem "injustas."

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Drummond é um pilar de força para Sam, quando ele se prepara para retirar as amídalas, mas o que acontecerá quando Drummond descobrir que será companheiro de quarto de Sam quando ele se submeter a uma "pequena" cirurgia de joelho?

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold acha que a feira de ciências da escola é a chance ideal para sabotar o projeto de sua colega de sala menos favorita, mas ao olhar de perto, ele se pergunta se as grosserias dela não são, na verdade, um grito de socorro.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Arnold é indicado juiz do tribunal escolar, ele logo enfrenta o risco de perder uma amizade de longa data ou perder um encontro com uma gatinha da escola - todos terão a sua chance no tribunal.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Arnold e Sam se rastejam através das fendas da casa assombrada do bairro, eles descobrem que o fantasma possui diversas surpresas - a maior de todas é um amor pelas pessoas e desprezo para a guerra.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Sam visita uma gravação de "The Sandy Squirrel Show", ele fica arrasado com a notícia de que seu programa de TV favorito está prestes a ser cancelado.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Sam deve escolher entre uma cobertura e um boteco quando o seu verdadeiro pai bate à porta de Drummond, querendo levar o Sam com ele. Cantor/compositor Hoyt Axton é o convidado especial no papel do pai de Sam, Wes McKinney.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: "O Gooch" volta para provocar o Arnold e mira em um novo alvo -- Sam -- só para enfrentar o seu novo desafio contra o novo vizinho de Drummond, uma estudante de intercâmbio italiana.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Visando ser eleito diretor de entretenimento para um fundo de caridade escolar, Arnold promete conseguir uma celebridade -- mas quando chega a hora, ele é forçado a pedir ajuda à sua inimiga Carmella, esperando que ela possa salvar o dia.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O empreendedor Arnold reluta em permitir que Sam faça parte do seu novo esquema, quando Sam percebe que apenas Arnold ficará com os lucros, ele acaba com a parceria e vira um concorrente.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
